planets.name: Kepler-37 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-37 with a 39.8-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-37 d was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around Kepler-37. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BONOMO_ET_AL_2023): disc_year 2013, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 4; pl_orbper 39.79222264, pl_radj 0.18110478, pl_bmassj 0.0062927

quotes.title: Kepler-37d
quotes.card: Kepler-37d is an exoplanet discovered by the Kepler space telescope in February 2013.
quotes.introduction: It is located 209 light years away, in the constellation Lyra.
